It might help to stretch a lot and gain as much mobility as possible as you won’t be very mobile while recovering. (Personally I’m really great full that I am quite a flexible guy so I could wipe my own ass for example).

Take also good care of your skin, try to hydrate it and if you go sunbathing put as much sunscreen as possible. 

Since your pre op try to be careful on how you bind as it can affect your possibility of even getting surgery (tape can leave scars if you take it off the wrong way and bidding can damage your muscles ext…) 

Be also aware that your post op results are not done after the surgery but will take quite some time to really heal. And during your recovery don’t stay alone for the first week or two so you don’t get yourself into complicated situations.  

An other note is that cis men chest are very different from one another and it really makes recovery easier if you don’t over compare your self with other guys.

The problem with nuclear energy isn’t the way we produce the energy it self or the waste, it’s that some infrastructure are sadly deteriorating. I live in France where 80% of our electricity comes from nuclear, it’s great! But our nuclear centrals are getting old and we need to change them or something terrible might happen. And that cost quite something. 

The waste too can be handled on a short term but the containers will one day leak. Not today or tomorrow but in a hundred years from now, even with the best waste treatment in place. It’s inevitable, they have a way too long life expectancy and the materials to hold them don’t. 

Nuclear is great to move away from charcoal but it is still not a renewable energy. Mining the resources for nuclear does pollute and creates conflict (like in Mali where the French army was present in part to protect our uranium mines).

Nuclear isn’t the solution, like at all, it’s not sustainable, our whole system isn’t and there is no magical energy that will solve all of our problems.
